rawFindings.title: `req.protocol` now ignores trusted hop-count proxy settings
rawFindings.explanation: Changing the trust check to `trust(this.connection.remoteAddress)` drops the hop-count argument that Express passes to `trust proxy fn` when proxy trust is configured as a numeric distance. With `app.set('trust proxy', 1)`, `trust` returns false for the socket address and the request falls back to `http` instead of honoring `X-Forwarded-Proto`.
rawFindings.suggestion: Pass the hop index expected by the trust function, e.g. `trust(this.connection.remoteAddress, 0)`, so numeric trust-proxy configurations continue to work.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `app.set('trust proxy', 1)` and a request carrying `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`, `req.protocol` returns `http` instead of `https`, so `req.secure` is false on TLS-terminated proxy setups.
